player_0.content: New plan: I got stuck in an infinite loop between Closet, Wine cellar, and Bar, repeatedly traversing the same edges without ever exploring the other available directions (specifically, I ignored 'west' in the Bar and 'south' in the Closet after the first visit). Next time, I will maintain a mental set of visited rooms and unvisited directions. Upon entering a room, I will check if all adjacent directions have been tried; if a new direction exists, I will take it immediately. I will only output "DONE" when I have returned to a room where all possible directions have already been explored and no new rooms remain to be visited.
